# Rok Retar — Mobile Engineer

> Rok Retar is a Slovenian mobile engineer specializing in Android and Kotlin Multiplatform. He architected and executed a complete corporate migration transitioning production iOS systems to shared Kotlin. This site showcases projects, engineering articles, and professional experience. The site itself is built natively in Kotlin with Kobweb.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.retar.app/)
- [Parrot — EPUB Reader & Audiobook Player](https://www.retar.app/parrot)
- [Building a Smooth, Infinite Carousel in Kobweb](https://www.retar.app/blog/infinite-carousel)
- [Shipping SQLCipher inside a static Kotlin/Native framework](https://www.retar.app/blog/sqlcipher-static-kotlin-native-framework)

## About
Rok Retar is a mobile engineer based in Slovenia. He engineers Android and Kotlin Multiplatform systems, including migrating a company's iOS app to shared Kotlin. Specializations include KMP migrations, native architecture, Jetpack Compose, and Kobweb. He has shipped production iOS apps backed by shared Kotlin code — not prototypes, but live products in the field.
